newsitem.title: USA: Cyberonics said costs expected to rise.
newsitem.headline: Cyberonics said costs expected to rise.

text.p: Cyberonics Inc said thursday in an earnings report that it expects to incur substantial additional costs associated with U.S. marketing and sales activities beginning with the first fiscal quarter of 1998.
The stock is down six percent in mid-morning Nasdaq trading, currently off 7/8 at 13 even.
The company added that it also expects these costs to increase in subsequent quarters as U.S. launch activities progress on its epilepsy and other neurological disorder treaments.
